name: Argentine National Immigration Service
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.70). Replaced keyword guess "logic-error".
rootCause: It is said that hackers used the encrypted virus NetWalker to enter the database and steal information from federal agencies. The dark web payment page linked in the ransomware description shows that the hacker initially paid $2 million worth of bitcoin to unlock the file. Within a week, this number had increased to 355 BTC, which is approximately $3.62 million.The Argentine government refused to pay the ransom.
